doc: Village and wildlife life by listening (M3-AUD-814; ADR 0031; docs/kb/tech/audio_runtime.md "Life"). LifeAudio (game/audio/life_audio.gd) watches each node whose script's global class (or its `audio_class` meta) is a `hooks` row and never writes it. pending: the class has not landed on this branch yet (claude/creatures); the checker skips its name until it does. Each frame, every watched node within hear_m of the ear (the viewport's camera) is read. villager (creatures' FieldNpc): a chat turn starting (speaking_method, else the speaker_prop naming id_prop) plays a murmur turn in the villager's voice (voices[npc_id], else low or high by a hash of the id) at head_m over its feet; while working() it plays its work row (work.rows[npc_id]) at work_point() every work.every_sec. wildlife (creatures' WildlifeLayer, positions in the layer's space): each gull flock calls every gull.call_every_sec from one of its gulls; a gull entering takeoff_state claps off; a crab entering flee_state scuttles (crab.cooldown_sec apart per beach); a shoal's startle (startle_method, else startle_prop rising above 0) darts. Randomness is a RandomNumberGenerator on `seed`.

villager._note_speaking: chat_speaking() is requested from creatures (M3-AUD-815); until it lands, the private _chat_speaker is read (never written) and compared with npc_id while chatting() is true

steps._note: M3-AUD-826: each villager walks on its own FootstepAudio (footsteps.json, with these keys over it): quieter, a shorter stride, cloth but no hero gear.

crab._note: WildlifeCrabBeach.State {IDLE, WALK, FLEE, WARY, RETURN}; a crab's pos is (x, z) with its y apart

fish._note: startled() is requested from creatures (M3-AUD-815); until then the private _startle timer is read
